author: Emoduckky
body:
Could use a little advice.

Alrighty so I’m a level 204 Nyx Cataphract and this level 174 atlas V, has been taking all of my territory extremely fast as if there was no issue with tier whatsoever. When I take his territory I can 2 tap them and they hardly do any damage. What’s up with that?  When I’m even just 3 levels below someone it’s tough as hell but this man can handle me with a whole tier and 25 level disadvantage. Is there something I’m missing here? Any help would be great!

author: Emoduckky
body: My weapon is actually a 190% ithra sword I just switched it cause I thought maybe he was applying water defense

author: PacersPK
body:
Try for more ward. Check your off hand stash for something with higher ward. Set your AI self to defender. Grab a pale dragon pet to counter any status-ing he's hitting you with. Use accessories/gear that prevent def↓, along with freeze, sleep, stun, etc.

That said, if you're a ghost where he's grabbing, it doesn't really matter what your set up is.

author: Javi_Wan
body:
Cool equipment! But i recommend you to have two different sets, one for defense and one for attack. The one I see here, looks more oriented to attack, with the fairy ring for mana. In defense mode, AI has unlimited mana so I would give it another kind of accesory, maybe one that negates def down, so you can switch to bear might.Maybe mimic is proccing def down and this atlas is taking advantage of that. Double def up is 50% but double def down is -80% so you are losing defense even fully buffed with that setup.

This setup works with you in command, but ai messes a lot. I had one similar, with debuffs (like miasma and stun) and buffs, and I saw I was losing territories, and after fighting myself I Was seeing that I almost never attacked (And I had a default stance, to try to proc attacks). I put a high guard shield, removed this situational skills and left high damage and cost attacks, and my territories are much better defended.

In the offesive I switch to some mana accesories, debuffs, and risky buffs like mimic and berserk. When I'm done, I load again the defensive set.

author: SyrupV
body: He could very well be using things like stun and sleep on you. or even killing you with status effects like blight and poison. As a level 211 myself they allow me to take down people around 240+. Also you may have your defender set to buff up a lot, maybe try setting him to an offensive mode instead. Good luck!
